example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.sampling import regular_grid
x,y=np.meshgrid([0.,.5,1.],[0.,.5,1.])
r=regular_grid(x,y,values=[x+y],nx=4,ny=5)
assert len(r)==3 and r[2].shape==(4,5)
